title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing
why_read: A technically solid but incremental training-free video-editing framework with decent benchmark improvements, of interest mainly to specialists in generative video editing.
analysis: EditVid combines several existing ideas (sparse causal memory, attention-based token injection, latent blending) into one training-free pipeline supporting multiple video-editing paradigms, showing improved FiVE-Acc scores versus a strong baseline and a user preference study. The contribution is an engineering combination rather than a fundamentally new technique, useful for practitioners in the generative video space but of narrower general interest. Numbers seem meaningful but the field moves fast and such training-free frameworks are common.
